toml-values.toml:
schema_version = 1
output = 1
package = "example.server"
model_package = "example.models"
include_timestamp = "yes"
formatters = ["nope"]
custom_formatters = ["ok", 1]
custom_formatter_kwargs = 1
selection = 1
export_bindings = {}

toml-selection.toml:
schema_version = 1
output = "server"
package = "example.server"
model_package = "example.models"

[selection]
include_operations = ["/paths/~1pets/get", {pointer = "/paths/~1pets/post", document = "spec/api.yaml"}]
include_tags = ["pets"]
exclude_operations = [{pointer = "/paths/~1health/get"}]
exclude_tags = ["admin"]
reason = "Pets only"

toml-records.toml:
schema_version = 1
output = "server"
package = "example.server"
model_package = "example.models"
formatters = ["black", "isort"]
formatter_settings = "pyproject.toml"
custom_formatters = ["formatters.fixture"]
custom_formatter_kwargs = {width = 100, ratio = 1.5, names = ["a", "b"], nested = {flag = true}}
encoding = "utf-8"
header = "Generated."
include_timestamp = true
model_mode = "verify"

[[builtin_codec_compatibility]]
name = "orders"
backend = "pydantic_v2.BaseModel"
schemas = [{pointer = "/Order", document = "spec/common.yaml"}]

[[export_bindings]]
schema = {pointer = "/components/schemas/Pet"}
module = "example.models"
symbol = "Pet"
direction = "response"

toml-record-errors.toml:
schema_version = 1
output = "server"
package = "example.server"
model_package = "example.models"

[[builtin_codec_compatibility]]
name = "orders"
backend = "pydantic_v2.BaseModel"
contract = "builtin-v2"

[[export_bindings]]
schema = {pointer = "/Pet"}
module = "example.models"
symbol = "Pet"
direction = "sideways"

toml-record-values.toml:
schema_version = 1
output = "server"
package = "example.server"
model_package = "example.models"

[[builtin_codec_compatibility]]
name = "users"
backend = "pydantic_v2.BaseModel"
dependencies = ["x", "x"]

[[export_bindings]]
schema = {pointer = "/Pet"}
module = "example models"
symbol = "Pet"

toml-record-backend.toml:
schema_version = 1
output = "server"
package = "example.server"
model_package = "example.models"

[[builtin_codec_compatibility]]
name = "users"
backend = "attrs"
